events.info: Eddie Clendening is a dynamic rockabilly artist celebrated for his authentic sound and electrifying performances. With a career rooted in classic rock and roll, he has toured extensively with his band, The Blue Ribbon Boys, and notably portrayed Elvis Presley in the Broadway musical The Million Dollar Quartet. His music blends traditional rockabilly with elements of country and rhythm & blues, delivering a vibrant, vintage energy.

events.info: The Fall Showcase will be a joyful celebration of dance featuring an inspiring mix of classical and contemporary pieces created by Grand Rapids Ballet Company members and Grand Rapids Ballet School faculty.
